name: Consulting Page – Contact Form → Gmail Notification

nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes:
Receives POST from Next.js /api/webhook/contact.
Expected body: { name, email, subject, message }

parameters.subject: ={{ `Thanks for reaching out, ${$json.name}!` }}
parameters.message:
={{ `Hi ${$json.name},

Thanks for reaching out! I received your details regarding '${$json.subject}' and I'm currently reviewing them.

I'll get back to you with initial thoughts and next steps by the end of tomorrow.

Best regards,
Derrick Odiwuor` }}

nodes.name: Gmail – Send Confirmation
nodes.notes:
Sends auto-reply to the VISITOR (lead) confirming receipt.

Fields used:
- sendTo    → {{ $json.email }}       (the lead's email)
- subject   → 'Thanks for reaching out, {{ $json.name }}!'
- message   → plain-text confirmation referencing subject + name

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Returns 200 OK + { status: "success", message: "Notification sent" } to Next.js form
